$$ 5 \text{ days} \times 8 \text{ hours/day} \times 2.5 \text{ mph} = 100 \text{ miles} $$

He needs to pack about 0.5 pounds of supplies for every mile he hikes, so the total amount of supplies he needs is:  
$$ 100 \text{ miles} \times 0.5 \text{ pounds/mile} = 50 \text{ pounds} $$

He also knows that he can get 1 resupply during the hike that will be 25% as large as his first pack. This means the resupply will be:  
$$ 0.25 \times \text{first pack} $$

Let the amount of supplies in his first pack be $ x $. The total supplies he will have is:  
$$ x + 0.25x = 1.25x $$

Since the total supplies needed is 50 pounds, we set up the equation:  
$$ 1.25x = 50 $$

Solving for $ x $:  
$$ x = \frac{50}{1.25} = 40 $$

$$

$$
4k - 4 = 92
$$

$$
4k = 96
$$

Dividing both sides by 4:  
$$
k = 24
$$

$$
3(24) - 4 = 72 - 4 = 68
$$
